title: Chapter 282 General
content:
Chapter 282 General

At the altar 5 kilometers away from Nanshanji, Takker was kneeling on one knee, staring at the altar with bated breath.

The altar of the dead not only has the function of converting dead soldiers, but can also be used as a teleportation array and a summoning array.

At this time, a two-headed wolf with a length of ten meters was enduring great pain in the altar.

Its whole body was burned red, and then condensed into a piece of frost.

The strange thing is that there is no such alternating state of cold and heat to destroy the body.

It can be seen that this ice and fire demon wolf has mastered the two abilities to perfection.

Although this area is under the charge of Takker, the identity of this fire wolf is not ordinary.

He is one of the seventy-two generals directly under the Black Dragon King, and everyone has a title.

His identity is higher than that of a commander like Takker.

Takker has five small commanders under him. Except for Hazamu who was frustrated in attacking Wana Town, the others have won the battle and brought a large number of sacrifices, which gave him enough resources to summon this ice and fire demon wolf.

One of the heads of the ice and fire demon wolf spewed out a large piece of flame, directly igniting a forest in the distance.

Then, another wolf head spewed out a large piece of ice, freezing the surrounding land.

"Awoo..."

He howled happily twice, and the sound seemed to contain some kind of magic. The huge air wave almost made the large number of skeleton soldiers standing by the side unstable.

You know, the level of these skeleton soldiers is as high as level 58.

Takker currently has 1,200 troops, and the other four small commanders have obtained a large number of human corpses, with the number reaching more than 5,000.

It's just that the newly converted skeleton soldiers are of low level, which has a strong relationship with the combat power of the corpse itself.

A level 30 human corpse is directly halved after being converted into an undead.

Takle didn't want to use the Skeleton Sea Tactics.

So he didn't rush to summon all the small commanders to attack Nanshanji.

You know, every skeleton soldier is very important to him. If he can gather a large number of skeleton soldiers, he will definitely be rewarded and become a great commander in the near future.

So, in order to preserve his strength, he chose to let his men quickly plunder corpses, energy crystals and soul crystals from other places.

As long as he has these resources, he can summon high-level warriors to preserve his strength.

Seeing the warriors in front of him, he knew that his plan was successful.

After summoning the Ice and Fire Demon Wolf, Takle believed that the bronze wall of Nanshanji could no longer resist.

His 1,200 people were enough to flatten this town.

"Takle, you did a good job. I will remember the merits of this battle and report it to General Arif Ubol when the time comes."

"Thank you, Demon Wolf King."

...

At this time, a roar of Marty came from far away.

The earth trembled, and flags were flying in the distance, smoke and dust were everywhere, and a cavalry unit rushed over quickly.

The Demon Wolf King exerted force on his limbs, jumped up, and jumped more than 30 meters away.

He looked at the cavalry rushing over with a disdainful expression.

"Just came here, there is a warm-up activity, not bad, it's just right to stretch your muscles."

On the other side, Wang Shuo, Gong Zheng, and Ayub were driving side by side, and Gude was the vanguard in the front.

In a blink of an eye, they were about to collide head-on with the skeleton soldiers.

But frontal combat was not what Gude's archers were good at. He immediately led the archers to launch a round of projectiles, and then dispersed to both sides.

Leaving the road open for the Hell Knights and the Golden Fire Cavalry to charge.

When Gude saw the Ice and Fire Demon Wolf, his eyes were leisurely and solemn.
